items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Philly Joe, Papa Jo - you name it - Shelly Manne, you name it.

ctx.x: I certainly have. Brown:…I mean, your first recording is with Elvin. You know, and we can bring in everybody.
Philly Joe, Papa Jo - you name it - Shelly Manne, you name it.
So what is it, when you, the last time we saw you perform live was at the IAJE when you had Sherman Ferguson, rest in peace…
